text.en: Image history now compares saved versions with the original and offers full-resolution saving from images and previews. Canvas review failures identify model-estimated safety overflow instead of only showing an internal error code.
text.zh-CN: 图片历史支持按版本对比原图与成品，历史图片和大图预览支持保存完整清晰度图片；画布复审失败会说明模型估计的安全区越界原因。
